name: Ohadnice Israeli Address Checkout
author: Ohad Yifrah

sections.description:
Customers type “ראשלצ”, misspell their street or forget the house number. The parcel comes back and you pay for shipping twice.

This plugin suggests Israeli localities and streets while the customer types, using the official streets list published by the Israeli government on data.gov.il (about 1,300 localities and 62,000 streets, including alternative street names).

  • City suggestions, including common abbreviations such as ת”א, ראשל”צ and פ”ת, with bigger cities first
  • Street suggestions limited to the streets that actually exist in the chosen city
  • Optional: block the order when the city is not a real Israeli locality
  • Optional: require a house number in towns with a full street list
  • Optional: require a valid Israeli phone number
  • List of cities you do not ship to
  • Works with the classic checkout and the block checkout
  • Keyboard and screen-reader friendly suggestion list
  • No API keys, no external services: all data ships with the plugin

Credits

Street and locality data: data.gov.il, “רשימת רחובות בישראל – קובץ עם סינונימיים”, Population and Immigration Authority.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Israeli address and choose the options you want.
sections.faq:
Does it send customer data anywhere?

No. The suggestions are computed in the customer’s browser from files bundled with the plugin.

Where does the data come from?

From the dataset “רשימת רחובות בישראל – קובץ עם סינונימיים” (Israel streets list with synonyms), published by the Population and Immigration Authority on the Israeli government open data portal: https://data.gov.il/dataset/israel-streets-synom

The data is free to use under the data.gov.il terms. The update date of the bundled copy is shown in WooCommerce > Settings > Israeli address.

What about moshavim and kibbutzim?

The official list is incomplete in many small localities: some have no streets in it at all, others only one or two. The street field always accepts free text, so customers there can type their address as usual, and a house number is only required in towns with 10 or more streets in the list.

How often is the data updated?

The government updates the list monthly. New plugin versions ship with the latest list.

short_description: Israeli address autocomplete for WooCommerce: city and street suggestions at checkout from the official government list. Fewer failed deliveries.
